## Volcano Giant (CR 14)

**XP** 38,400  
 CN Huge humanoid (earth, fire, giant)  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +18  

**Defense**

 **AC** 29, touch 9, flat-footed 28 (+2 armor, +1 Dex, +18 natural, –2 size)  
 **hp** 300 (20d8+140)  
 **Fort** +18; **Ref** +9; **Will** +9  
 **Defensive Abilities** rock catching; **Immune** fire  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to cold  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  
 **Melee** Gargantuan longspear +25/+20/+15 (4d6+16, crit x3) or 2 slams +24 (2d6+11)  
 **Ranged** rock +15 (2d6+16 plus 1d6 fire)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon, rock throwing (120 ft.), trample (2d6+16; DC 31)  
 **Spell-like Abilities** (CL 20th):  
 1/day—stone shape  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 32, **Dex** 12, **Con** 23, **Int** 10, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +15; **CMB** +28; **CMD** 39  
 **Feats** Awesome Blow, Cleave, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Powerful Maneuvers](../../rules/feats/powerful-maneuvers.md), Intimidating Prowess, Iron Will, Vital Strike, [Weapon Focus (longspear)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md), [Lightning Reflexes](../../rules/feats/lightning-reflexes.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Diehard and Endurance are one feat, Toughness; Improved Bull Rush, Improved Sunder are covered by Powerful Maneuvers; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (longspear), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +14 (+18 jumping), Climb +18, Intimidate +20, Knowledge (nature) +10, Perception +18 **Languages** Giant, Ignan  
 **SQ** oversized weapon use  
 **Gear** Gargantuan longspear, leather armor  

**Special Abilities**

 **Breath Weapon (Su)**  Three times per day, a volcano giant can exhale a cloud of warm and sulfuric gas in a 30-foot cone. Affected creatures must make a successful DC 26 Fortitude save or take a -4 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, checks and saves for 1 minute (10 rounds) due to fits of coughing and choking. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

 **Oversized Weapon Use (Ex)**  A volcano giant wields a Gargantuan two-handed longspear without penalty.  

 **Volcano Giant Characters** **+22 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +12 Constitution, +2 Wisdom**: A volcano giant’s prowess lies almost entirely in his physical abilities, predominantly strength.  

  **Huge**: Volcano giants are huge and take a –2 penalty to AC, –2 penalty to attack rolls, +2 bonus to Combat Maneuver Bonus and Combat Maneuver Defense, and a –8 penalty to Stealth checks. A volcano giant’s lifting and carrying limits quadruple those of Medium characters.  

  **Space** 15ft., **Reach** 15ft.  

  **Speed**: A volcano giant’s base speed is 40 feet.  

  **Low-light vision**: Volcano giants can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.  

  **Racial Hit Dice**: A volcano giant starts with seventeen levels of giant, which provide it with 20d8 HD, a base attack bonus of +15, and base save bonuses of Fort +12, Ref +6, Will +6.  

  **Defensive Abilities**: A volcano giant gains the rock catching defensive ability.  

  **Racial Skills**: A volcano giant’s giant levels give it skill points equal to 20 x (2 + Int modifier). Its class skills are Acrobatics, Climb, Intimidate, Knowledge (nature), and Perception.  

  **Racial Feats**: A volcano giant’s giant levels give it ten feats.  

  **AC**: Tough-skinned, volcano giants gain a +18 natural AC bonus.  

  **Special Attacks (see left)**: Breath weapon, rock throwing, trample.  

  **Spell-like Abilities**: Volcano giants can cast stone shape 1/day as a 20th level caster.  

  **Special Qualities (see left)**: fire and earth subtypes, low-light vision, oversized weapon use.  

  **Automatic Languages**: Giant, Ignan. Volcano giants with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Draconic, Goblin, Terran, Orc.

**Ecology**

**Environment** warm mountains  
 **Organization** solitary, gang (2–5) or band (6–9 plus 35% noncombatants plus 1 adept or cleric of 1st or 2nd level), hunting/raiding party (6–9 plus 1 adept or sorcerer of 3–5th level plus 3–8 fire lizards); or tribe (21–30 plus 1 adept, cleric, or sorcerer of 6th or 7th level plus 12–30 fire lizards)  
 **Treasure** standard
